description: Saas-Almagell is the highest village of the Saas valley, gathered around the white parish church of St Barbara beside the Saaser Vispa. The church on this site was built from 1938, and the high peaks rise beyond the roofs. This is not the Allalinhorn glacier above Saas-Fee, and the valley floor is free of snow at the end of September. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear, with only a little cloud, a cool north wind, and no rain.
